programme.desc: 5 choses étonnantes sur - 5 choses étonnantes sur Darth Maul: 5 anecdotes incroyables sur les personnages, les stars ou les films les plus célèbres du cinéma et des séries.5 histoires à raconter à vos amis !

programme.title: Smiley Face Killers
programme.desc: Un joueur de foot se sent poursuivi par quelque chose, quelqu'un.

programme.title: Blockbusters 80
programme.desc: "Blockbusters 80" nous replonge dans les films d'action iconiques des années 80, symboles d'une époque.

programme.title: Le Duel
programme.desc: Un Texas Ranger enquête sur une série de décès inexpliqués dans une ville appelée Helena.

programme.title: Le 12ème homme
programme.desc: Il s'agissait de 12 saboteurs. Les nazis en tuèrent 11. C'est l'histoire vraie de celui qui s'est enfuit.

programme.title: Coup de Foudre à Oxford
programme.desc: Caro Drake, émotionnellement gardée, arrive à Oxford avec le seul objectif d'obtenir son doctorat, mais à travers une amitié turbulente avec un charmant jeune homme, Caro commence à s'ouvrir au mystère des nouvelles expériences, à la vulnérabilité et à l'amour.

programme.title: Comment j'ai kidnappé mon boss
programme.desc: Plongez dans la comédie loufoque d'Anna, mère célibataire de deux enfants, qui, pour éviter de se faire licencier par son patron amnésique, va lui faire croire qu'il est le père de ses enfants... Une histoire drôle et romantique, à partager en famille !

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Love, et autres drogues
programme.desc: Un représentant médical pour Pfizer, coureur de jupons et désorienté (Jake Gyllenhaal), tombe amoureux d'une jeune femme atteinte de la maladie de Parkinson (Anne Hathaway) dans cette romance fascinante.

programme.title: Un amour de jeunesse
programme.desc: Camille, 15 ans, vit un amour passionnel avec Sullivan mais celui-ci disparait à la fin de l'été. Huit ans plus tard, elle le croise de nouveau...

programme.title: Meurtres au féminin
programme.desc: Eva est une jeune femme flic chargée des affaires de vols au sein de la ville de Barcelone. Un jour, elle est appelée en urgence pour rejoindre l'unité qui traque une tueuse en série ayant pour cible les vieilles femmes. Alors qu'un vent de panique s'abat sur la ville, la jeune femme pourtant novice dans ce genre d'affaires, va tenter de mettre la main sur la meurtrière… C'est sans ompter la bataille personnelle qu'elle va devoir mener de front contre son inspecteur en chef, qui passe son temps à lui fermer la porte au nez et lui compliquer la tâche au sein de l'unité.

programme.title: Horse camp
programme.desc: Une jeune fille se rend dans un centre équestre et apprend le véritable pouvoir de l'amitié...

programme.title: Fandango
programme.desc: A 12 ans, Claire se prend d'affection pour un pur-sang, nommé Fandango. La jeune fille découvre alors que l'animal est traumatisé par l'accident de son cavalier, l'ancien champion Cal Masterson. Avec l'aide de Cal, elle fera tout pour aider son cheval à surmonter ses peurs.

programme.title: Une Mère Diabolique
programme.desc: Lorsque Allison, 14 ans, perd son père dans un accident d'avion, trois ans après la mort de sa mère adoptive, elle est dévastée. Lors des funérailles, elle est choquée de rencontrer sa mère biologique, Jessica. Elle et sa demi-sœur Sydni seront encore plus choquées de découvrir que Jessica a un plan infâme pour contrôler les 40 millions de dollars dont Allison doit hériter.

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Sidney Young est un intellectuel désabusé qui adore autant qu'il méprise le monde des célébrités, de la gloire et du glamour. Son magazine alternatif, Post Modern Review , se moque des stars obsédées par les médias et va à contre-courant des tendances. Lorsqu'on lui propose un poste dans le très conservateur magazine new-yorkais Sharps , c'est un véritable choc ! Il semble que Clayton Harding, le rédacteur en chef de Sharps , ait été amusé par la perturbation d'une soirée post-BAFTA par Young, accompagné d'un cochon déguisé en Babe. Commence alors la descente de Sidney vers le succès : il passe progressivement du statut d'outsider moqué à celui de confident de la starlette Sophie Maes. Au début, il est aidé chez Sharps par sa collègue Alison Olsen, qui cache elle aussi un secret. Leur amitié y survivra-t-elle ?

programme.title: La Femme Idéale
programme.desc: Deux amis d'enfance se retrouvent adultes pour s'aider à conquérir les femmes de leurs rêves. Chris veut épouser Allison, une fille juive, tandis qu'Adam est sur le point d'épouser Hannah, une femme avec qui il n'est pas heureux. Lorsque Chris demande de l'aide à Adam pour se faire passer pour juif afin qu'Allison sorte avec lui, les cultures se heurtent et le chaos s'installe !

programme.title: War of the Dead
programme.desc: Des chercheurs nazis inventent un virus pour transformer leurs prisonniers en zombies.

programme.title: L'Employeur
programme.desc: Cinq candidats se disputent le même emploi dans une grande entreprise. Ils apprennent qu'ils seront testés, mais se retrouvent piégés dans une pièce à se battre pour survivre, car un seul obtiendra le poste.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Au début des années 2000, une adolescente catholique et bien rangée découvre la tentation sur un chat aol.

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Que faire quand on est les deux agents les plus nuls du FBI, qu'on est chargé d'escorter deux bimbos blondes menacées d'enlèvement, mais qu'on a un accident ? Prendre la place des deux minettes pour la soirée top-fashion de l'année !

programme.title: Espion Et Demi
programme.desc: Un boxeur professionnel doit aider un agent du gouvernement américain à retrouver un avion espion disparu avant qu'il ne tombe entre les mains de terroristes.

programme.title: Touche Pas A Mon Gazon
programme.desc: Dick (Jim Carrey), jeune cadre dynamique, vient tout juste d'être promu à un poste de communications important au sein de la grosse société Globodyne, quand il doit expliquer à la télévision pourquoi le PDG (Alec Baldwin) vient brusquement de se débarrasser de ses actions.

programme.title: S.O.S Fantômes II
programme.desc: Après l'extermination totale de tous les revenants dans la ville de New York, la joyeuse équipe de S.O.S Fantômes reprend du service (après un chômage technique long de cinq ans) quand leur amie Dana découvre que son bébé Oscar est l'objet de phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Témoin à Louer
programme.desc: Doug Harris a un vrai problème: le jeune homme, qui n'a pas une vie sociale très riche, est sur le point de se marier, mais n'a pas de témoin.

programme.title: Allumeuses!
programme.desc: Trois amies croquent la vie à pleines dents et n'ont pas besoin d'hommes pour être heureuses. Jusqu'au jour où l'une d'entre elles tombe amoureuse... Christina s'est toujours efforcée de respecter une règle d'or en matière de mecs: "Eviter toute relation sérieuse avec le sexe opposé".

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Stuart Little est de retour dans une nouvelle comédie pleine d'action et d'aventure. Avec tous vos personnages préférés du premier film, mais aussi des nouveaux – et encore plus d'effets spéciaux incroyables. STUART LITTLE 2 ose aller là où aucune souris n'est jamais allée auparavant !

programme.title: Le Chevalier black
programme.desc: Jamal Walker est un employé de Medieval World, un parc à thème vétuste. Il se retrouve soudain projeté dans le passé, au cœur de l'Angleterre du XIVe siècle.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Les Femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: La balade de Lefty Brown
programme.desc: Le boxeur Chris, l'acteur déchu Peter et le spécialiste excentrique de la publicité Max économisent depuis des années pour réaliser leurs rêves et préparer leur avenir. Malheureusement, le directeur de banque Schumacher a délibérément laissé leurs comptes d'investissement tomber à zéro afin de se débarrasser du conseiller en placements névrosé Tobias.

programme.title: Two Eyes Staring
programme.desc: Paul, Christine et leur petite fille de 9 ans, Lisa, forment une famille ordinaire. Ils héritent d'une effrayante demeure laissée par la mère de Christine avec laquelle ils n'avaient plus de relations. Peu de temps après avoir emménagé, Lisa a d'étranges visions et se rend compte que sa sinistre nouvelle amie n'est autre que le fantôme de la jumelle morte de sa maman. Le père de Lisa finit lui aussi par suspecter sa femme de cacher un horrible secret, ce qui aura des conséquences mortelles….

programme.title: La Caverne
programme.desc: Refusant d'accepter que sa chienne Maxine brûle désormais en enfer, le jeune Nathan, dévasté, est constamment tourmenté par des cauchemars et des visions infernales.

programme.title: Heartless
programme.desc: Jamie Morgan, un jeune homme portant une grande tache de naissance en forme de cœur sur le visage, découvre qu'il y a des démons dans les rues de l'est de Londres.

programme.title: Terreur Sur La Lagune
programme.desc: Le corps d'une jeune fille est retrouvé dans un pré, le meurtrier ne sera pas retrouvé. Des années plus tard, un jeune homme appelé Stefano retourne sur l'île de son enfance pour revoir son frère, le prêtre local...

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: Un groupe d'amis part en week-end à la campagne, mais découvre qu'un chasseur local leur pose problème. Ceci dit, cela n'est rien face à l'invasion extraterrestre qui menace la Terre.

programme.title: UFO
programme.desc: Une horde d'OVNIS envahit le ciel de Londres dans le but d'anéantir toute forme de vie humaine.

programme.title: Le dernier refuge: Au revoir monde
programme.desc: Alors qu'une attaque cyberterroriste plonge le monde dans le chaos, un groupe d'amis trouve refuge dans une maison de campagne. Confrontés à un avenir incertain, des tensions font surface.

programme.title: La guerre des mondes: L'invasion
programme.desc: Trois amis fans d'astronomie cherchent le point d'impact de ce qu'ils croient être une météorite.

programme.title: Robocop Les visages d'Eve
programme.desc: La chaine 100% science-fiction et fantastique. Zone réservée aux fans de films et séries SF : catastrophes, zombies, extraterrestres, paranormal, space opéras, vampires, mondes perdus et créatures mutantes sont au programme

programme.desc: La chaine 100% science-fiction et fantastique. Zone réservée aux fans de films et séries SF : catastrophes, zombies, extraterrestres, paranormal, space opéras, vampires, mondes perdus et créatures mutantes sont au programme

programme.title: Stonewall
programme.desc: Des émeutes ont éclaté au bar Stonewall Inn à New York. Cela changera à jamais la lutte pour les droits des homosexuels et donnera naissance par la suite à la première marche des fiertés.

programme.title: Box 27
programme.desc: Tom vit avec son père dans un conteneur, dans la pauvreté et le bonheur. Mais tout change lorsqu'un travailleur social de la protection de l'enfance intervient.

programme.title: Troisième étoile à droite
programme.desc: James et ses amis proches poursuivent un voyage malavisé le long des côtes du Pays-de-Galles. Dans cette aventure touchante et comique, l'amitié, l'héroïsme et l'amour vont se côtoyer.

programme.title: L'Oracle
programme.desc: Dans la Perse du XIe siècle, un apprenti chirurgien se déguise en Juif pour étudier dans une école qui n'admet pas de chrétiens.

programme.title: Dans les griffes de mon sauveur
programme.desc: Découvrez l'histoire de Laura sauvée par Bruce, un homme mystérieux... Une histoire à glacer le sang, qui remet en question les apparences.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Un rite d'initiation d'une fraternité universitaire tourne mal. Un étudiant blessé par balle et une employée de supérette kidnappée se retrouvent au foyer de la fraternité. La panique persiste.

programme.title: The river king
programme.desc: Un jeune inspecteur de police d'une petite ville doit enquêter sur la noyade d'un étudiant. Le directeur de l'école étouffe le scandale en présentant ceci comme un suicide.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: Cinq hommes mariés se partagent secrètement un loft à New York pour assouvir tous leurs fantasmes. Mais la combine tourne au cauchemar quand ils découvrent le cadavre d'une femme inconnue.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: Après avoir été ressuscité par une entité sinistre, Art le Clown revient dans la ville de Miles County où il prend pour cible une adolescente et son jeune frère le soir d'Halloween.

programme.title: Scanners II
programme.desc: Un commissaire de police convoite le poste de maire dans sa ville. Pour renforcer la lutte contre la criminalité, il recrute des scanners, êtres dotés de pouvoirs surnaturels leur permettant de s'introduire dans l'esprit des humains.

programme.title: Faux Semblants
programme.desc: Deux vrais jumeaux, gynécologues de renom, partagent vraiment tout dans leur vie. Un jour, une actrice vient les consulter et les deux frères en tombent amoureux...

programme.title: Scanners III
programme.desc: Héléna et son frère, Alex, sont tous deux des scanners. En proie à de terribles maux de têtes dus à ses pouvoirs, Héléna décide d'absorber une drogue expérimentale mise au point par son père, tandis que son frère se réfugie dans un monastère en Thaïlande. Héléna se transforme alors en véritable machine à tuer. Devenue incontrôlable, elle assassine son père adoptif, libère un groupe de Scanners enfermé dans un hôpital et met au point un plan machiavélique afin de réduire le monde en esclavage.

programme.title: The Moderator
programme.desc: Après les meurtres de deux de ses amies, Mya Snik, une jeune blogueuse, mène l'enquête.

programme.title: Armed Response
programme.desc: Des soldats sont prisonniers d'une enceinte gérée par une intelligence artificielle.

programme.title: Black Water
programme.desc: Un agent capturé tente de s'échapper d'une prison secrète sous-marine.

programme.title: Tuer pour Survivre
programme.desc: Un mercenaire tente de se racheter après avoir été l'homme de main impitoyable d'un syndicat.

programme.title: Battlestar Rebellion
programme.desc: Un vaillant cosmonaute va découvrir une mystérieuse terre régie par les Pères Inconnus, cinq gouverneurs anonymes manipulant la conscience des habitants par le biais d'émetteurs spéciaux.

programme.title: Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: Dans l'ancienne Grande-Bretagne, des forces saxonnes venues de l'Est attaquent le peuple celte. Arthur, un guerrier banni, et Merlin, un sorcier ermite, s'unissent pour sauver le peuple..

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Giulia est une jeune pilote prometteuse des courses GT. Lorsque sa vie s'effondre, son seul espoir est son frère, ancien champion de rallye devenu drogué.

programme.title: Harcelés
programme.desc: Pour Chris et Lisa, emménager dans leur maison de Lakeview Terrace est un rêve devenu réalité. Pourtant, rapidement, les deux jeunes gens deviennent la cible de leur voisin, qui désapprouve leur relation interraciale. Cet homme strict et austère, père célibataire et policier, s'est autoproclamé responsable de la sécurité du quartier.

programme.title: Underworld: Blood Wars
programme.desc: Selene, aidée de son allié David, est de retour pour faire régner l'ordre entre vampires et loups-garous. Un nouveau chef est apparu chez les Lycans, tandis que du côté des vampires, une ambitieuse recrue s'active...

programme.title: L'Art De La Guerre 2
programme.desc: L'agent spécial Neil Shaw est de retour dans ce nouveau film d'action et d'aventure où tous les coups sont permis. En retraite, Shaw est consultant à Hollywood mais reprend du service quand l'un de ses maîtres en arts martiaux se fait tuer. Shaw se retrouve au milieu des intrigues politiques de Washington lorsqu'il découvre un complot visant à assassiner plusieurs sénateurs.

programme.title: Ennemis rapprochés
programme.desc: La force des convictions d'un jeune Irlandais l'oppose aux idéaux de son hôte, et les met tous les deux en danger.

programme.title: Le Complexe Du Castor
programme.desc: Walter Black, victime d'une dépression, a négligé sa famille et laissé son entreprise à la dérive. Sa vie bascule lorsqu'il trouve une marionnette de castor. Utilisant celle-ci pour s'exprimer, il retrouve sa joie de vivre.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Un fermier recueille un homme blessé avec une sacoche pleine d'argent. Lorsqu'une bande vient réclamer l'argent, il doit décider à qui faire confiance. En défendant un siège, il révèle un talent de tireur d'élite qui remet en question sa véritable identité.

programme.title: Waiting for the barbarians
programme.desc: La prise de conscience d'un magistrat d'une petite ville coloniale après avoir été témoin des mauvais traitements subis par les prisonniers de guerre.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Lors d'une nuit fatidique dans un petit théâtre régional d'Angleterre pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, une troupe d'acteurs met en scène une représentation du "Roi Lear" de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Ultraviolet
programme.desc: Alors qu'une guerre civile entre les humains et les vampires ravage la Terre au 21e siècle, une jeune femme doit protéger un petit garçon de neuf ans menacé de mort.

programme.title: The Package (Killers game)
programme.desc: Un coursier pour un seigneur du crime local doit livrer un mystérieux paquet tout en étant poursuivi par une horde de gangsters peu ordinaires.

programme.title: Tokarev
programme.desc: Paul Maguire est un homme d'affaires respectable et un père aimant qui mène une vie paisible, jusqu'au jour où son passé violent revient le hanter. Lorsque sa fille se fait kidnapper, Paul réunit son ancienne équipe pour l'aider à la retrouver... par tous les moyens nécessaires.

programme.title: Bullet proof

programme.title: Signs of Evil
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler's Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity's original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler's “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Project Tiger
programme.desc: “Project Tiger” is the largest and most ambitious conservation project in history. Its success is celebrated around the world, but until now the full story has remained hidden. Marking “Project Tiger's” 50th Anniversary this documentary offers intimate wildlife sequences with rare insight into the tigers' personal world and the ancient forests where they thrive, while unique access to never-before-seen undercover footage reveals the shocking truths of multi-national wildlife crime networks. Set against the backdrop of India's extraordinary growth and transformation, this incredible story is told in full for the first time by the people who have lived and breathed the traumas and the triumphs of five decades of tiger conservation in India.

programme.title: Indochina's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Indochina three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: Time Flies
programme.desc: We like to think we can control everything: changing the course of water, reclaiming land, replanting deserts – we constantly remodel the natural world to suit our needs. But there's one thing we can't control: the passing of time. However, we can change how we see things using cameras we can start to see the world in different time frames. Now we can see animals following the sun, mass movements of the changing seasons and even the vast impact of the changing weather. Watch what happens when time flies…

programme.title: Antelope
programme.desc: For some the word ‘antelope' might not incite much interest but look closer and you'll discover a remarkably diverse group of animals, numbering nearly one hundred different species. Some are easy to miss, the little dik-dik being barely the size of a house cat, while eland weigh in at more than half a ton. There are representatives roaming plains from the Mongolian Plateau in Asia to the cape of South Africa. Wherever you find them, these remarkable animals are the unsung heroes of the plains.

programme.title: Marine Mammals

programme.title: The Return of the Osprey
programme.desc: The Osprey is the only raptor in the world to feed exclusively on fish. This migratory bird has lived throughout central Europe for a long time, nesting there in the summer months. But the species has gradually moved to more northerly regions of the continent, far from the persecution caused by human expansion. Wendy and Denis have set launched an ambitious challenge of reintroducing the Osprey to Switzerland, a century after its disappearance.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.title: Montenegro
programme.sub-title: From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

Although the Seychelles has only 0.13 percent of Germany's land area, its new marine reserve is larger than the Federal Republic: A dream for the conservationists, who are supported by the Seychelles government.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard. The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs

Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs

But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Hopping Cough Smurfs: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs

Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Smurf Who Would Be King: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.desc: In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. ""What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?

The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Pants On Fire
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Safarnama
programme.desc: Safarnama is more than just a mere journey one wants to complete just to check out that one task from the ‘ToDo List”. It is something just one of its kind. In Safarnama, we are up for a soulfulfilling journey with Ankit Siwach that is to begin in Mumbai and cease at Ladakh. This journey is to witness numerous unseen moments and unfelt experiences via a thrilling, adventurous route. It isn't just about navigating roads using GPS but more of digging deeper into the beauty of India to understand life better.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology - Colour change with the power of thought - The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.
